display_long_description:
Inundate your senses, immersed in the mesmerizing movement of energetic flows. Dive into millions of particles, trails, and volumetric forms, art-directed to abstract the natural motion of energy in our universe. 

A visual album featuring 12 meditative seated experiences, totaling over an hour of content, paired with original music and rendered in stereoscopic 3D, up to 8K resolution and 90fps.

Tracks:
Golden Gust – Swirling golden winds undulate in gentle, turbulent flows.
Rainbow Clouds – Billowing volumetric clouds drift and swell in radiant cycles of color.
Shimmering Shoal – A vast shoal of particles flocks, ripples, and shimmers with motion.
Zen Garden – Explosive fractals resonate through a tranquil field of sand.
Geyser Burst – Surging trails erupt upward, bursting and spraying droplets of water.
Ink Drop – Plumes of diffusive ink unspool and stratify as they dissolve around you.
Magic Fountain – Whimsical surges of energy transmute into beautiful forms and detonate.
Pulsar Orb – A pulsing orb of abstract energy oscillates with hypnotic resonance.
Dust Storm – Roaring dust fields blast toward you in calming waves.
Swirling Vortex – A towering helix of wind evolves with twists and whirls.
Waterfall – Streaming sheets of particles cascade and splash off rocks toward you.
Wormhole – Travel through dimensions as a breathing portal of energetic flux expands and contracts.

Experience the afterglow of Energies, as if the motion continues around you.
